mapper.select:
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY LAST_MDF_DT DESC) AS LISTNUM, PRCDOC_SNO, PRCDOC_NO, PRCDOC_NM, DOC_TYP_CD, PRT_NO FROM GE_PL_PRCDOC01_M WHERE DLT_YN = 'N'
AND LAST_UPDR_ID = #{LAST_UPDR_ID}
AND PRCDOC_NO LIKE '%'||#{PRCDOC_NO}||'%'
AND PRCDOC_NM LIKE '%'||#{PRCDOC_NM}||'%'
ORDER BY LAST_MDF_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_PL_PRCDOC01_M ( PWPL_ID, PRCDOC_SNO, PRCDOC_NO, DOC_TYP_CD, PRT_NO, PRCDOC_NM, FIRST_CRTE_DT, FIRST_CRER_ID, LAST_MDF_DT, LAST_UPDR_ID, DLT_YN ) VALUES ( #{PWPL_ID}, (SELECT NVL(MAX(PRCDOC_SNO), 0) +1 FROM GE_PL_PRCDOC01_M), #{PRCDOC_NO}, #{DOC_TYP_CD}, #{PRT_NO}, #{PRCDOC_NM}, SYSDATE, #{FIRST_CRER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{LAST_UPDR_ID}, 'N' )
